hold_text: The MI-281 dispatch says in terms: 'THE FIX IS TIER-2. Prepare it, validate it, and route it to the manager for the operator's OK before it lands. Declare landing: hold with a typed hold_reason. Never self-land an order-path change, whatever the row says and however obviously correct the fix looks.' I am holding on that instruction and declaring it as what it is. ⚠️ BUT THE INSTRUCTION'S PREMISE DOES NOT HOLD FOR THIS DIFF, AND SAYING SO IS THE POINT OF THIS FIELD RATHER THAN QUIETLY SELF-LANDING ON IT: the dispatch assumed this lane would WRITE the order-path fix. It did not, because U1/U2/U3 were ALREADY LANDED AND DEPLOYED before the lane opened (46e1efb1f, PR #11435, 2026-09-08T18:53Z; /api/diag/version read 2026-09-12T05:47:40Z gives git_sha == git_sha_on_disk == c5a0ba993, restart_pending false, containing it by merge-base --is-ancestor). So this diff carries NO order-path change and no src/, config/, deploy/ or workflow change at all — verified with `git status --porcelain src/ config/ deploy/ .github/`, which returns empty for the first three. It is docs plus this declaration. The manager may lift this hold to landing: self on that basis without re-asking the operator; I did not take that decision myself because the instruction was explicit and it is not a session's call to decide an operator instruction is moot. ⚠️ THE ONE JUDGEMENT IN HERE THAT IS WORTH A HUMAN READ is what the OPEN-ITEMS row now says: all three clears_when clauses carry evidence, but clause (3) is met ONLY by its `or` branch, and the NINE unestablished pre-deploy false-close candidates are PERMANENTLY unadjudicable because position_idx/exchange_read_source did not exist when those rows were written (0 of 993 pre-deploy rows carry them). One of the nine is trade 5461 on REAL-MONEY bybit_2. The row is deliberately NOT removed from OPEN-ITEMS.json by this lane — it is loud, it is real money, and the positive observation is n=2 on one symbol — so removal is routed as a decision rather than taken on a session's own judgement.
